The per-rep purchase-order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The full test suite passes (`mvn -q -o test`). I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example or run it separately.

The change is in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The count subquery now has `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, the same filter the other purchase-order reports use. I updated the Javadoc to say "non-cancelled".

I didn't touch the ordering or the zero-count rows. Reps without purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, highest count first.

My first attempt at the edit didn't apply, so the first test run was against unchanged code. The passing run is the one after the edits.
